title: asset-gen v2 core: finalize verb, review tiers, spend guard (plus the independent gateway probe)
goal: Cut the manual steps and the review load of one asset-gen run without weakening provenance, QA or the human approval gate.

tasks.objective: Add assetgen.py finalize --run <run>: after fetch_outputs it runs defringe (only for alpha purposes), embed and qa in that fixed order, so embed can never be skipped before qa. Put the logic in a new module scripts/assetgen/finalize.py with a thin hookup in assetgen.py; extract the qa logic that is inline in main into a function. defringe refuses when qa.json or an image review already binds the outputs, so finalize skips defringe when defringe.json after_pixels_sha256 still equals the current pixels, and passes --force only when the user gives it. Refuse an approved run (rewriting approved bytes fails gen-run-outputs). fail() exits the process, so pre-check conditions instead of catching SystemExit. Print which reviews became stale. Add the verb to the write-verb list in scripts/factory-cmd.py. Existing verbs keep their contracts.
acceptance: finalize runs defringe (alpha purposes only), embed, qa in that order and stops at the first FAIL, naming the step
a second finalize on an unchanged run is idempotent and does not hit the defringe refusal
finalize refuses an approved run and prints the stale reviews it caused
exit codes follow qa: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 3 NOT_AVAILABLE
defringe, embed and qa keep their individual contracts (existing tests unchanged and passing)
factory-cmd lists finalize as a write verb

tasks.objective: Record whether the image gateway returns more than one image for n greater than 1, and which sizes it returns, with at most 2 low-quality generations that the user approved in the current task. The NineRouterImage node fixes n at 1 and keeps only the first image, so the probe reuses the node's request code outside ComfyUI, reads credentials at run time as the node does and prints none. Result goes to docs/plans/assetgen-batch/probe.md. NOT_RUN (no approval or no gateway) is a valid result and then the optional node-n item stays in the backlog.
tasks.grade_reason: a findings document; no product code
acceptance: probe.md states the observed result (images returned, sizes) or NOT_RUN with the reason
no credential, host address or URL appears in the file
at most 2 low-quality generations were made, and only on the user's explicit word

tasks.objective: Add review tiers without touching run.md, purpose files or requirements_sha256. A new data file scripts/assetgen/data/review-tiers.json maps purpose ids to tier light (icon, ui-element, texture-tileable); anything else is full, which equals today's behaviour. The quality plugin computes the tier at check time: for a light run the gen-run-claude-review check gives no WARN when review-image-claude.json is missing, but a present file is still validated. A run with selected style-lock anchors is always full. Codex prompt and image reviews are untouched.
acceptance: a light-tier run with no review-image-claude.json produces no gen-run-claude-review WARN
a present but invalid or stale review-image-claude.json is still reported
a run with anchors is full: the missing Claude review still WARNs
an old run.md without any tier information gives the same result as before
no change to the gen-run schema, purpose files or the requirements hash

tasks.objective: The engine has no spend control (only skill prose). Add resolve --max-outputs N (default 4) that records spec.budget.max_outputs in the run's spec.json, and a read-only-by-default assetgen.py budget --run that prints used versus allowed (outputs plus failed attempts) and exits 1 when exceeded. The logic lives in a new scripts/assetgen/budget.py; finalize reports the budget state. Document the limit as advisory: the engine cannot stop comfy-mcp, so the skill runs budget before each run_workflow.
acceptance: resolve --max-outputs N records the limit; the default is 4 and an invalid value is a usage error (exit 2)
budget --run reports used, allowed and exits 1 when used exceeds allowed
finalize prints the budget state without changing its exit code semantics
runs resolved before this change (no spec.budget) are treated as unlimited, not as failing

tasks.objective: Update the skills and docs for finalize, tiers and the spend guard. In skills/asset-gen/SKILL.md steps 6-7 replace the defringe, embed, qa chain by finalize, describe the light tier and run budget before each run_workflow; keep the file at most 160 lines by compressing. Mirror the idioms in skills/comfyui/SKILL.md, the domain doc and scripts/README.md, and update evals/asset-gen-icon/criteria.md if it names the old chain. Also reword the conclusion of docs/plans/assetgen-batch/probe.md so it is unambiguous: the gateway ignores n greater than 1 (observed once, model cx/gpt-5.6-sol-image), so the optional node n parameter is dropped and is not added to the backlog; batch variants are separate calls. State in skills/comfyui and the domain doc that image QA reads the real returned size (the probe saw 1254x1254 for a 1024x1024 request).
tasks.grade_reason: prose and skill text only; the verbs are tested in the earlier tasks
acceptance: asset-gen SKILL.md is at most 160 lines and names finalize, the light tier and the budget check
skills-lint passes and python3 -B scripts/checks/skill-citations.py reports no MOVED or broken citation
no instruction lets an agent skip embed before qa or approve a run
probe.md states the node n decision in one sentence without an alternative reading
